title: 第一章：今天开始营业 · 第一节：老板的第一天
description: 清晨醒来 · 检查厨房 · 商定菜单与采购 · 启程进城
source: 原创奇幻剧情与四道分段听力理解题，非考试原文。
audioLabel: 离线英文角色配音 · 独立场景环境音

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Morning light falls through the repaired window. The roof is dry, and cups clink downstairs.
lines.translation: 晨光穿过新补好的窗沿。屋顶不再漏雨，楼下传来杯碟轻碰的声音。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Lu Chuan, are you awake? Your first day as an innkeeper has begun.
lines.translation: 陆川，醒了吗？你的第一天老板生活开始了。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I am awake. My shoulders still think we are carrying boards.
lines.translation: 醒了。只是我的肩膀还以为我们在搬木板。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: I checked the beams and stairs. They are secure. Last night was worth the effort.
lines.translation: 我检查过横梁和楼梯，都很稳。昨晚没有白忙。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Good news. The bad news is that the breakfast I promised is still missing.
lines.translation: 好消息。坏消息是，我答应的早餐好像还没着落。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: We have water, a pot, and a little bread. Opening for guests will take more than that.
lines.translation: 有水，有锅，也有一点面包。不过，要营业还差得远。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: So a place to sleep and a tavern ready for business are two different things.
lines.translation: 原来一间能住的屋子，和一间能开门的酒馆，是两回事。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Ingredients, a menu, and supplies for our guests. Let us make a list first.
lines.translation: 食材、菜单，还有招待客人用的东西。我们先列清单。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The roof is fixed. Today we can finally think about what goes into the pot.
lines.translation: 屋顶已经修好，今天总算可以考虑锅里放什么了。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Have breakfast first. A hungry innkeeper will not take good care of anyone.
lines.translation: 先把早餐吃了。老板饿着肚子，可招待不好别人。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: They enter the kitchen. The hearth is clean, but most of the pantry shelves are empty.
lines.translation: 两人来到厨房。炉灶已经清理干净，储藏架上却空了大半。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: This cupboard is honest. It tells us exactly what we are missing.
lines.translation: 这个柜子倒是很诚实，一眼就知道我们缺什么。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Buy flour, eggs, and vegetables first. Then get salt and lamp oil.
lines.translation: 先买面粉、鸡蛋和蔬菜，再补盐和灯油。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Should we keep the menu simple? Hot soup, bread, and a plate of eggs.
lines.translation: 菜单先做简单一点？热汤、面包，再加一份煎蛋。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: That suits travelers. What we can serve matters more than a beautiful menu.
lines.translation: 适合赶路的人。做得到的，比写得漂亮的更重要。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then no list of ten special dishes. On the first day, we will do three things well.
lines.translation: 那就不写十种招牌菜了。第一天，先把三样做好。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: I will arrange the tables and check the cups. You can buy supplies at the town market.
lines.translation: 我留下整理桌椅，检查杯碟。你去镇上的集市采购。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: On my own? I have not even learned all the road signs yet.
lines.translation: 一个人去？我可能连路牌都还没认全。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Follow the main road outside. Cross the stone bridge to reach the town gate. Avoid the mine road to the north.
lines.translation: 沿着门外的大路走，过石桥就是镇门。别走向北边的矿道。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Main road, stone bridge, town gate. Got it. The mine is not on today's shopping list.
lines.translation: 大路、石桥、镇门。我记住了。矿道今天不在清单里。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Keep the list and money safe. Buy the essentials first, before a pretty sign distracts you.
lines.translation: 把清单和钱收好。先买必需品，别被漂亮的招牌吸引走。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Do not worry. Reading instructions is my strength. Being an innkeeper is the new part.
lines.translation: 放心。我擅长看说明，只是还没学会当老板。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lu Chuan slips the shopping list into his satchel. The stone road is dry, and the breeze smells of grass.
lines.translation: 陆川把采购清单放进挎包。门外的石路已经晒干，风里有青草的气息。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: If you meet travelers on your way back, tell them we will open soon.
lines.translation: 回来时，要是看见赶路的人，可以告诉他们这里快开门了。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Last night we only wanted a dry roof. Today we are preparing to welcome guests.
lines.translation: 昨晚我们只是想找个不漏雨的地方，今天就要招待客人了。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: We do not have to do everything at once. Start with a seat and hot soup for the first guest.
lines.translation: 不用一口气做好所有事。先让第一位客人坐下，喝上一碗热汤。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then I will bring back the ingredients for that soup. The waystation is in your hands.
lines.translation: 那我去把热汤的材料买回来。驿站就先交给你了。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: I will be here when you return. Take care on the road.
lines.translation: 嗯，我在这里等你。路上小心。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Aelia returns to the hall. Lu Chuan follows the road toward town. The tavern's first menu is still only a sheet of paper in his bag.
lines.translation: 艾莉娅回到大厅，陆川沿着石路走向镇门。酒馆的第一份菜单，还只是挎包里的一张纸。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The first step to saving the world... buy some eggs.
lines.translation: 拯救世界的第一步……先去买鸡蛋。

questions.prompt: Why is the waystation not ready to welcome guests yet?
options: They need ingredients, a menu, and supplies.
questions.explanation: 屋顶与楼梯已经修好，但食材、菜单和接待用品仍需准备。

questions.prompt: Why do they keep the first menu simple?
options: They want to serve dishes they can prepare well.
Aelia refuses to use the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 第一天先把热汤、面包、煎蛋三样做好；能实际提供餐食比漂亮的长菜单重要。

questions.prompt: What should Lu Chuan buy before looking at attractive signs?
options: The essentials on the shopping list.
questions.explanation: 艾莉娅提醒他保管清单和钱，先买必需品，不被漂亮招牌带走。

questions.prompt: What will Lu Chuan do while Aelia prepares the hall?
options: Explore the mine to the north.
Follow the main road across the stone bridge to buy supplies.
Wait upstairs for the first guest.
questions.explanation: 艾莉娅留下整理桌椅与杯碟；陆川沿大路过石桥，到镇上集市采购，暂不探索北边矿道。

ending: 菜单与采购分工已确定。陆川启程前往边境小镇，艾莉娅留在驿站准备大厅。第一章第二节“集市：不愿透露姓名的少女”已开放。
